meta.title: Source document manifest
meta.note: Every source document referenced in data/history.json (reports and audits), data/counties-cob.json and data/national.json. sha256 is computed over the exact PDF bytes downloaded from the Parliament of Kenya library (DSpace bitstream). A hash is recorded only when the file was downloaded and its MD5 matched the checksum the library publishes; otherwise sha256 is null and access says why. retrieved is the date the figures were read; hashed_on is the date the file was downloaded and hashed. Documents from sites that publish no checksum (parliament.go.ke, siaya.go.ke) are not hashed even when downloaded: sha256 is null and access says so. The World Bank API (data/national.json) is a live service, not a file: its responses are not hashed; each indicator records the API's last_updated date.
meta.method: Item resolved through https://libraryir.parliament.go.ke/server/api (items, bundles, ORIGINAL bitstreams); file fetched with curl -L from the bitstream content URL; MD5 compared with the library checkSum; SHA-256 computed locally.
